description:
A super top-up health plan covers the total hospital bills up to the limit specified in your super top-up plan above the deductible amount. 

In this video, we have share 5 Super Top-Up Health Insurance Plans & compared them on the basis of features, eligibility , waiting periods , riders as well as calculated premiums for the plans.

5 Super Top-Up Plans in India 2025 :-
1. Niva Bupa Health Recharge
2. HDFC ERGO Medisure Super Top Up
3. ICICI Lombard Activate Booster
4. Aditya Birla Super Top Up Plan B
5. Tata AIG Medicare Plus
